rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the fundamental values guiding a person, group, or movement.

example.english: This group's ethos is clear: it always puts members' interests first.
example.traditional: 呢個團體嘅價值觀好清楚，凡事都以會員利益行先。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tyun4 tai2 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1 hou2 cing1 co2 faan4 si6 dou1 ji5 wui2 jyun4 lei6 jik1 haang4 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the ethos is presented as the spirit or guiding character of a movement, group, or people rather than as explicit values.

example.english: The whole protest was full of an ethos of solidarity.
example.traditional: 成場示威都充滿住團結一致嘅精神。
example.jyutping: sing4 coeng4 si6 wai1 dou1 cung1 mun5 zyu6 tyun4 git3 jat1 zi3 ge3 zing1 san4

rows.note: Use this mainly for the shared ethos of an organization, workplace, or community, as in its way of thinking and doing things.

example.english: Our company ethos is to encourage everyone to speak up directly when there is a problem.
example.traditional: 我哋公司嘅文化係鼓勵大家有問題就直接講。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 man4 faa3 hai6 gu2 lai6 daai6 gaa1 jau5 man6 tai4 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2
